easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Incredible Hulk.
description:
Cast Sozin's Comet from your hand by paying {3}{R}{R} or from exile for its foretell cost by paying {2}{R}, giving each creature you control firebending 5 until end of turn.
Declare The Incredible Hulk as an attacker. Its firebending ability triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Pyrohemia by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and player.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, untapping it and giving you an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

uses.name: Bruce Banner // The Incredible Hulk
uses.cardState: as The Incredible Hulk and without summoning sickness

uses.name: Sozin's Comet
uses.cardState: was foretold on a previous turn
